close_reason: Already documented: backend.rs:81-86 says 'size (Email only): Set to 0. The backend MUST update this to the actual byte size... Failing to replace these sentinels will cause the client to receive invalid wire values'.
description: email.rs line 1403: size is hardcoded to 0 as a placeholder, with a comment that the backend assigns the real value in create_object. The comment does not state what happens if a backend implementor forgets to assign size — the stored email will have size=0 permanently with no error. The invariant 'create_object MUST replace size' is load-bearing for MailBackend implementors and should be stated in the MailBackend::create_object doc comment in backend.rs, not only in a local comment at the call site.
title: size placeholder invariant not complete
